json_contract: Original two-field JSON, command first in supervised targets. Visible explanation tokens have zero loss. Same command, visible example and format across arms. Only the raw-trace supervision differs.

promotion.training_eligibility: At least 8 distinct official TRAIN source questions across 3 skills; report count by intent as well. On each, each teacher must pass on at least 2 of 3 draws (native outcome plus checked explanation); at least one admissible raw trace each. Student must show at least two certified instances of the same attributable error in 3 draws. Output truncation and an unreviewed command are separate categories.
promotion.independent_eval: Use frozen source partitions. Do not report held-out accuracy unless actually scored. Never select topics or checkpoints using confirmation.
promotion.checkpoint: Choose highest paired behavior pass rate on DEV, then highest retention on separate development retention, then earliest step. Keep final held-out retention scores locked. With this small holdout report exact paired counts by source.
promotion.multisource: 3 matched arms x 3 training seeds, common canonical answer and matched command loss weight. Save 16/32/64; compare frozen confirmation and retention at 4096, then budget sensitivity at 1024. Report GPU time and generated tokens.
